reason: Verdict from the unchanged frozen evaluator across source/structural checks and all five native physics trials.
author_claim_reason: All five locally simulated public seeds passed force-driven opening, closure, payload retention, contact, penetration, stability and interior-clearance checks. All five source surfaces match exactly, and the final packaged scene has the same geometry and physics as the tested first candidate. Independent acceptance has not been observed.
author_limitations: Physics collision shapes approximate the source: drawer walls are axis-aligned slabs; the collision floor is 4.5 mm below the unchanged source floor, limiting the specified initial payload overlap to 3.5 mm.

Cabinet collision approximations omit thin source aperture lips that intersect the source drawer shell, plus decorative legs/upper shelving frame. Cabinet remains anchored; its full source visual mesh remains visible.
Drawer mass is an assumed 3 kg; center of mass, solid-envelope inertia and friction are documented simulation abstractions, not measured furniture properties.

The tests are our own implementation of the public force protocol on OvPhysX 0.4.13 CPU, not independent evaluator results. Exact evaluator random-number consumption and solver configuration were not inspected.

The pinned OvPhysX runtime crashed on a second initialization in one process. Completed seeds were therefore run in separate fresh processes; error logs are preserved. No installed packages or runtime source were changed.
The renderer completed on the assigned GPU with driver/display and fallback warnings recorded in its logs. No required physics capability was missing.
evaluation_limitations: Force-limited drawer actuation and authored mass/inertia/friction are simulation abstractions, not physical furniture or robot manipulation validation.
Five deterministic seeds do not estimate general reliability.
Contact field payload_drawer_contact_force_n stores impulse in N*s; divide by1/240s for average force. The frozen contact detector remains0.01N*s (2.4N equivalent), with acceptance unchanged.
Native CPU evaluation ran at nice15/idle I/O on the shared authoring host; instantaneous load was not matched.
